mapper.select: SELECT AUTHORITY_CODE as authorityCode, AUTHORITY_NM as authorityNm, AUTHORITY_DC as authorityDc, AUTHORITY_LEVEL as authorityLevel, TENANT_SCOPED as tenantScoped, USE_AT as useAt, CRT_DT as frstRegistPnttm, CRT_ID as frstRegisterId, UPD_DT as lastUpdtPnttm, UPD_ID as lastUpdusrId FROM tb_authorityinfo ORDER BY AUTHORITY_LEVEL, AUTHORITY_CODE

SELECT AUTHORITY_CODE as authorityCode, AUTHORITY_NM as authorityNm, AUTHORITY_DC as authorityDc, AUTHORITY_LEVEL as authorityLevel, TENANT_SCOPED as tenantScoped, USE_AT as useAt, CRT_DT as frstRegistPnttm, CRT_ID as frstRegisterId, UPD_DT as lastUpdtPnttm, UPD_ID as lastUpdusrId FROM tb_authorityinfo WHERE 1=1
AND USE_AT = #{useAt}
AND AUTHORITY_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND AUTHORITY_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND AUTHORITY_DC LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
ORDER BY AUTHORITY_LEVEL, AUTHORITY_CODE OFFSET #{firstIndex} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{recordCountPerPage} ROWS ONLY

AND USE_AT = #{useAt}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_authorityinfo ( AUTHORITY_CODE, AUTHORITY_NM, AUTHORITY_DC, AUTHORITY_LEVEL, TENANT_SCOPED, USE_AT, CRT_DT, CRT_ID, UPD_DT, UPD_ID ) VALUES ( #{authorityCode}, #{authorityNm}, #{authorityDc}, #{authorityLevel}, #{tenantScoped}, #{useAt}, GETDATE(), #{frstRegisterId}, GETDATE(), #{lastUpdusrId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_authorityinfo SET AUTHORITY_NM = #{authorityNm}, AUTHORITY_DC = #{authorityDc}, USE_AT = #{useAt}, UPD_DT = GETDATE(), UPD_ID = #{lastUpdusrId} WHERE AUTHORITY_CODE = #{authorityCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_role_menu_permission ( AUTHORITY_CODE, MENU_ID, PERMISSION_ID, USE_AT, CRT_DT, CRT_ID, UPD_DT, UPD_ID ) VALUES ( #{authorityCode}, #{menuId}, #{permissionId}, #{useAt}, GETDATE(), #{frstRegisterId}, GETDATE(), #{lastUpdusrId} )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.MENU_ID as menuId, m.MENU_NM as menuNm, m.MENU_DC as menuDc, m.PARENT_MENU_ID as parentMenuId, m.MENU_ORDR as menuOrdr, m.MENU_URL as menuUrl, m.ICON_NM as iconNm, m.USE_AT as useAt, CASE WHEN MAX(p.PERMISSION_LEVEL) = 'write' THEN 'write' ELSE 'read' END as permissionLevel, 1 as accessible FROM tb_menu_info m INNER JOIN tb_role_menu_permission rmp ON m.MENU_ID = rmp.MENU_ID INNER JOIN tb_permission_type p ON rmp.PERMISSION_ID = p.PERMISSION_ID WHERE m.USE_AT = 'Y' AND rmp.USE_AT = 'Y' AND p.USE_AT = 'Y' AND rmp.AUTHORITY_CODE = #{value} GROUP BY m.MENU_ID, m.MENU_NM, m.MENU_DC, m.PARENT_MENU_ID, m.MENU_ORDR, m.MENU_URL, m.ICON_NM, m.USE_AT ORDER BY m.PARENT_MENU_ID, m.MENU_ORDR, m.MENU_ID
